purpose: Replay the Stage68 frozen quality-plateau stable-redundancy portfolio rule once on the already collected EGFR and FA10 Phase-A matrices. This is a posthoc transfer replay, not an independent confirmation and not a new target protocol.

frozen_stage68_rule.stable_redundancy: R_ij=max(0,min_seed PearsonCorr(train-fitted receptor rank profiles)); only positive redundancy observed in every seed is penalized.
frozen_stage68_rule.quality_floor: For fixed k, mean singleton utility must be at least pair-off top-k mean singleton utility minus 0.5 times the root-sum-square jackknife singleton spread divided by k.
frozen_stage68_rule.solver: SciPy HiGHS MILP, exact pair-product linearization, zero requested MIP gap, 60 second time limit.
frozen_stage68_rule.rule_frozen_from: Stage68 selected_candidate uncertainty_0p5x; no coefficient, aggregation, threshold, fold, or subset-size tuning is permitted here.

evaluation.outer_folds: use frozen manifest outer_fold values 1 through 5; outer-fold labels remain unavailable to selection
evaluation.primary_metric: median-seed BEDROC alpha=20 using the Stage68 primary minimum-rank aggregation
evaluation.robust_metric: (primary median-seed BEDROC + mean seed BEDROC + worst seed BEDROC) / 3
evaluation.baseline: pair-off top-k singleton utility under the same outer-training data and same k
evaluation.transfer_success_definition: For both targets and both k values, mean robust BEDROC gain over pair-off is at least -0.01 and mean stable-redundancy reduction is nonnegative. This supports transfer of the constrained-selection application only; it does not establish efficacy, QUBO superiority, solver advantage, or quantum advantage.
